pricing: Free $0: unlimited topic draws (1, 3 or 5 at a time from a 250-topic library in English, Chinese, French, Indonesian, Arabic, Turkish, Thai and Hindi), the 1/2/3/5-minute timer and local recording, with no account and no credits; free accounts cannot request the AI report. Standard $19.9 a month for 2,000 credits a month; Pro $59.9 a month for 6,000 credits a month (the page calls it 3x the monthly credits), both 'valid for the current month; cancel anytime'. One-time packs, 'one-time payment, no auto-renewal': $5.00 for 500 credits, $10.00 for 1,000, $20.00 for 2,000. AI analysis is 100 credits a run, so a $5 pack is about 5 analyses, $10 about 10 (the card itself says 'Up to 10 AI analyses (100 credits each)'), Standard about 20 a month and Pro about 60 - roughly $1 an analysis on every path. Paid by card through Stripe; the plan prices, credit allowances and Stripe price keys also appear in the shipped app bundle. USD. Verified 2026-11-14.
best_for: People practising impromptu speaking on their own terms - language learners, teachers running a class warm-up, Toastmasters-style clubs, and anyone who wants to talk for one minute without freezing. The free path needs no account: draw 1, 3 or 5 topics from a 250-topic library in eight languages, pick a 1/2/3/5-minute timer, and record locally. The paid path is only for the AI speech report, which costs 100 credits a run (about $1 on every pack and plan), so it fits someone who wants grammar, filler-word and pacing feedback and is willing to pay per analysis. It is not a fit if you need a named company, a governing-law clause or a published refund term before you subscribe, if you object to ad-supported pages on a paid product, or if you want a human coach - the report is model output scored on six fixed dimensions.
